title: OOD-PerceptionBench golden bundle
description: Expected outputs for one smoke split, measured with a reference agent over several replicate runs. Written by tests/make_golden.py, consumed by tests/check_acceptance.py. Validated structurally by the harness (no third-party jsonschema dependency); this file is the normative description.

bundle_version.description: Release bundle this golden is valid for, e.g. 'v0.9'. The harness rejects a mismatch: a golden is only valid for the content-pack version it was measured against.

binds_to.description: arXiv version these numbers correspond to (coordinator standing rule 1).

reportable.description: Always false. Smoke-split scores must never be published as a benchmark result; seven-to-nine routes cannot approximate a claim computed over 55 base routes.

sha256.description: sha256 of SMOKE_SPLIT.tsv. The harness refuses a bundle whose split hash differs from the split being checked -- comparing across splits is meaningless.

version.description: Commit, tag, or checkpoint identity. Free-form but must not be empty. make_golden.py writes '<repo name>@<full commit> <entrypoint>'.

repo.description: Optional (absent from bundles built before it existed; make_golden.py always writes it). Public https URL of the agent's repository. Never a local path.

commit.description: Optional (make_golden.py always writes it). Full commit of a CLEAN checkout: make_golden.py refuses when `git status --porcelain` under the entrypoint's top directory is non-empty, because an untracked or modified file there may be what actually ran.

entrypoint.description: Optional (make_golden.py always writes it). Agent file relative to the repository root.

entrypoint_sha256.description: Optional (make_golden.py always writes it). sha256 of the entrypoint file at that commit.

env.description: Optional (make_golden.py always writes it). The agent.env every replicate ran with, from _runner/env_provenance.json; all must agree, and make_golden.py refuses unless DATAGEN is "0". null when the runner that made a replicate did not record it.

content_pack_sha256.description: Composite digest of the content pack. Rule (make_golden.py): sha256 of the canonical SHA256SUMS text built from content_pack_archives -- one line '<sha256><two spaces><archive name><LF>' per archive, sorted by archive name in byte order (LC_ALL=C sort). For a canonical sums file this equals `sha256sum SHA256SUMS`; for assets/SHA256SUMS it is exactly that. Bundles built before content_pack_archives existed carry an undocumented value here.

content_pack_archives.description: Optional (make_golden.py always writes it). Archive file name -> sha256, one entry per content-pack archive, in the order the composite rule sorts them. Source of truth: assets/SHA256SUMS.

os.description: Platform string of the host the replicates RAN on (Python's platform.platform()), from each replicate's _runner/report.json; all must agree. null when a replicate has no run report. Never the builder's platform, which ran no route; bundles made before make_golden.py read it from the replicates hold the builder's, which for the shipped v0.9 bundle was the same machine.

python.description: Python version that RAN the replicates. make_golden.py reads it from each replicate's _runner/env_provenance.json (all must agree) or, failing that, from --replicate-python. Never the builder's interpreter.

python_packages.description: Optional (make_golden.py always writes it). Versions of numpy, scipy and, if recorded, the carla client in the replicates' environment, from _runner/env_provenance.json. null when a replicate had no such file. Never a path.

seed.description: The published protocol is seed 42 only.

n_replicates.description: Independent runs of the whole split. >= 2 is required for the tolerance to be measured rather than floored; make_golden.py needs --allow-single-replicate to go below.

driving_score_abs.description: Absolute Driving Score tolerance for assertion A4. Required: a golden without a tolerance is a wish, not a golden.

policy.description: How the number above was derived, in words.

routes.description: Keyed by route path relative to the canonical routes root -- the same key the split uses. Must cover every route in the split; a partial bundle is rejected, because it would silently downgrade the uncovered routes to unchecked.

expected_blueprint_id.description: Blueprint the route XML asks for. Re-derived from the XML at generation time, not copied from the split.

observed_agent_type.description: type_id of the actor that actually spawned, read from record.ttr_dar.agent_type (which is the live actor's type_id). Equal to expected_blueprint_id in any bundle make_golden.py agrees to write.

replicates.description: Every per-replicate observation, kept so the tolerance can be audited rather than trusted.

published_seed42_driving_score.description: Optional. From the published records, for orientation only; never gating.
